Arrival task

lines: In your book: Watch Ruth and Dan. No writing yet.

detail.title: We do · source detective
lines: In your book: Write each action’s value; explain one match.

detail.title: Check the idea
lines: In your book: Write the letter of your answer. Explain one clue.

detail.title: Independent book check
lines: In your book: Write your route’s six answers using its sentence stems.

detail.title: Review and improve
lines: In your book: Read back one answer (?); improve it and mark //.

detail.title: Exit ticket
lines: In your book: Answer under today’s work: one value and one reason.
